<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script"> <sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"> <sys_id>43c05710b2f6499f80fa9365113012e1</sys_id> <sys_scope display_value="x_1973840_leave">9a92e189935c4710fd58f257dd03d607</sys_scope> <sys_update_name>sys_script_43c05710b2f6499f80fa9365113012e1</sys_update_name> <abort_action>false</abort_action> <access>package_private</access> <action_delete>false</action_delete> <action_insert>true</action_insert> <action_query>false</action_query> <action_update>true</action_update> <active>true</active> <add_message>false</add_message> <advanced>true</advanced> <change_fields>false</change_fields> <client_callable>false</client_callable> <collection>x_1973840_leave_cancellation</collection> <condition/> <description/> <execute_function>false</execute_function> <filter_condition/> <is_rest>false</is_rest> <message/> <name>销假申请验证</name> <order>10</order> <priority>100</priority> <rest_method/> <rest_method_text/> <rest_service/> <rest_service_text/> <rest_variables/> <role_conditions/> <script><![CDATA[ var leaveRecord = new GlideRecord('x_1973840_leave_request'); if (leaveRecord.get(current.original_leave_request)) { var totalCancelledHours = parseFloat(leaveRecord.cancelled_hours || 0) + parseFloat(current.cancel_hours);
if (totalCancelledHours > parseFloat(leaveRecord.leave_hours)) { gs.addErrorMessage('销假小时数不能超过请假小时数。请假总时数: ' + leaveRecord.leave_hours + '小时，已销假: ' + (leaveRecord.cancelled_hours || 0) + '小时，本次销假: ' + current.cancel_hours + '小时'); current.setAbortAction(true); return false; } } return true; ]]></script> <sys_policy/> <template/> <when>before</when> </sys_script> </record_update>
